stemMd: Which statement cannot be true in any permitted order?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Wood and Stone must not occupy consecutive positions.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Wood and Stone must occupy consecutive positions, in either order.

explanationMd:
Test whether each proposed statement can be added consistently to the rules. "Clay must precede Wood." is incompatible with every permitted order. The alternative statements each have a complete valid example, given in their feedback. To check impossibility, enumerate placements for the most restricted item or block, then remove every case breaking a rule.

Complete permitted orders (each arrow advances one position):
- Glass → Bronze → Wood → Clay → Stone
- Glass → Bronze → Wood → Stone → Clay
- Stone → Glass → Bronze → Wood → Clay
- Stone → Wood → Clay → Glass → Bronze
- Stone → Wood → Glass → Bronze → Clay
- Wood → Clay → Stone → Glass → Bronze
- Wood → Glass → Bronze → Clay → Stone
- Wood → Stone → Clay → Glass → Bronze
- Wood → Stone → Glass → Bronze → Clay
